description.content: Create and inspect payment sessions

Creates a payment session for a PSU to initiate an Immediate Transfer, Smart Transfer, or Buy Now Pay Later payment. To mix them in a single session, use the Payment Hub semantics. Signature, digest, date and x-request-id headers are mandatory in production.

PSD2 Payment Initiation Services exposed by Fintecture: Immediate Transfer, Smart Transfer (auto-reconciled via merchant-allocated virtual IBANs), Request To Pay (payment links via email/SMS/QR), Buy Now Pay Later, Verified Payout, and Immediate Refund. The /pis/v2/connect endpoint serves all three payment types and supports mixing them in the same session via the Payment Hub.
